The Text Auditor's failure to extract any text confirms the gibberish severity.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails critical functional checkpoints: 'Text... for public navigation' and 'Standardized typography' are completely absent due to AI-generated gibberish. While the general shape ('Rectangular panel') and color scheme align with the class, the lack of legible text renders the object functionally invalid as a street sign. The Fine Grained Classifier did predict 'street sign' (Top-1), indicating visual similarity, but the Text Auditor's empty output proves the semantic failure. 4/9 checkpoints passed (Geometry, Color, Material, Contrast), but the failure of the defining feature (text) heavily penalizes alignment.
